required_behavior: Require an accepted resolution assertion and explicit identity-issuing authority.
unsafe_inference: A high match score or entity-resolution cluster is a master identity.

required_behavior: Reference the source occurrence's immutable record identity and issue only master-domain assertions.
unsafe_inference: The MDM service registers or rewrites source-record identity.

required_behavior: Evaluate attribute-, context-, purpose- and valid-time-scoped authority.
unsafe_inference: The latest source value is automatically authoritative.

required_behavior: Treat it as a reproducible projection with candidates, provenance and residual conflicts.
unsafe_inference: The golden record is universal source truth.

required_behavior: Bind override authority, reason, scope, validity and expiry explicitly.
unsafe_inference: Manual override is an invisible highest-priority source.

required_behavior: Emit a correction intent to the owning port and reconcile its receipt.
unsafe_inference: A steward decision automatically mutates a source system.

required_behavior: Keep classification values and domain entities in separate identity contexts.
unsafe_inference: Every reference value is a mastered business entity.

required_behavior: Bind code, concept, designation, language and edition separately.
unsafe_inference: A displayed label is the stable code or concept identity.

required_behavior: Preserve historical resolution, status and replacement relations.
unsafe_inference: Retiring a code deletes its historical meaning.

required_behavior: Refuse unless the exact maintenance policy and scope explicitly permit reuse.
unsafe_inference: A retired code may be silently reused.

required_behavior: Retain the exact mapping relationship, evidence, context and loss profile.
unsafe_inference: A crosswalk row proves semantic equivalence.

required_behavior: Require an independently governed reverse assertion or refuse.
unsafe_inference: A forward mapping implies a valid reverse mapping.

required_behavior: Require the named human or institutional authority and an external receipt.
unsafe_inference: A model or agent may issue identity, waive conflict, approve a code or ratify a mapping.
